text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Neo Universe has an 
"announcement" for you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Orbital revolution. The Earth has 
completed one lap around its host star. 
Hence... 'Happy New Year.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was quite the grandiose New Year's 
greeting. Still, the concept of 
celebrating seems to exist within Neo 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, she enters the Classic 
division. What Neo Universe is aiming for 
is, naturally, the Classic Triple Crown, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe is still 
wavering......"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown—matches my 
wavelength. Utterly safe. But...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The entry velocity toward the "GATE" is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She casts her eyes down. Presumably, in 
that 'future prediction'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running the Classic Triple Crown route 
won't yield good results in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Perhaps that's the way they're 
reading the situation.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wants to form a "hypothesis." 
Perhaps――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Maybe there's a better course to sail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is there a path to becoming stronger 
outside of the Classic Triple Crown route? 
For instance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara route consists of the Oka 
Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or the mile route, centered around the NHK 
Mile Cup. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both are shorter than the Classic Triple 
Crown route. Considering the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe is transmitting... a desire 
to apologize to Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's a happy "Happy New Year," 
we're forcing exhaustion upon them, aren't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She looks downcast. It seems I really 
brought up too heavy of a topic right at 
the start of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe 'desires' New 
Year's recreation."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
During a few 'rotations', I will be on 
'break'... I would like to request how to 
spend it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New Year games. It might make for a nice 
diversion. What should I have Neo Universe 
try?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Mountain climbing at the start of the 
year... 'Mountain climbing,' huh. Reaching 
the summit... with Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
To the peak of the universe. To the place 
closest... to the cosmos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (VRRRROOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I went mountain climbing with Neo 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer—this direction.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Believe in Neo Universe. No matter how 
sharp—the "PATH" remains open.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe's way of mountain climbing 
was unique. Taking the pathless route, yet 
always being right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—we reached the summit. The climb was a 
success.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, transmitting signal in unison. 
3, 2, 1, 0."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Yoo-hoo."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through this New Year mountain climb, Neo 
Universe's sharp senses seemed to have 
been honed even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After having so much fun together, on the 
way back home—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Visiting power spots... A routine to 
gather one's vigor.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If that is so, Neo Universe has something 
she "wants to try."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has an idea of where to go. 
With that in mind, I decided to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-clack, click-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Entering—the sixth lap.
choice_data_list:
Um... we're just going around in circles 
on the train?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. ...Yes. Keeping the body 
perfectly still, all this time...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
This is the most "restful." Neo Universe 
is feeling energized.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Entrusting ourselves to the train with an 
unlimited-ride pass. During the ride, Neo 
Universe didn't move a single muscle."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent sense of composure. Thanks 
to this routine, her energy seemed to 
recover in no time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After having so much fun together, on the 
way back home—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
New Year's Karaoke Contest... "KARA"... 
"OKE"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Singing with Neo Universe, yes. Emitting 
strange sonic waves."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I really can't have her emitting 
ultrasonic screeches... So we decided to 
go to karaoke together.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: You're really good at the high notes!
You're really good at the high notes, huh!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that so? Neo Universe is merely 
vibrating the vertex of her head."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had quite a beautiful voice. A singing 
style with a unique rhythm that belongs 
entirely to Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, the music selection was 
rather peculiar...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe likes Italian prog rock. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That band's songs are "special." They're 
the very essence of Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe sang a variety of songs, 
honing all sorts of techniques.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After having so much fun together, on the 
way back home—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ââ!! Ah, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Space sign"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Guidance... has descended upon me. 
Guidance that... shows me the path.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ANOI"... The sign pointing somewhere 
other than the Classic Triple Crown is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding up her finger, Neo Universe began 
to trace letters in the air.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those words were—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: S E T O

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "SETO". It's See-too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Correct. "SETO." That is—the interstellar 
relay point.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand what it means. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
""SETO". Finding out what that means might 
just be the first step toward this year's 
great leap forward."
